title: Hexkill
summary: Hexkill is a spell used to disspell enchantments, and spells. The spell manifests as a stream of red or green energy from the hands of the user.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
A red version of this spell was used by Klaus to disspell Dante Vale's Stopglue power and free Brahe. [The Bookshop Hunter]

Rassimov used the spell in Atlantis to disable Lok Lambert's Darkfog spell. [Coming of Age]

A green version of this spell was used by Shauna to disintegrate White and Mallory's swords. [Lok and the Betrayer]
